name: Cinematic Music Pack
teaser: Cinematic music with tension in it.
description_html:
I have rewritten the music player so that it reloads 5 random songs at the start and 5 random songs at raid end from the custom music folder.

This should keep load times low if you have lots of music in the folder. It does take a couple seconds longer to see the raid end screen since i have to re-cache songs.

The songs on here are pretty varied but they all provide cinematic tension to it… a dark vibe to it.

To install:

1. Unzip to your SPT/Bepinex/Plugins folder.. If you installed correctly, you will see a folder called CustomMusic. Within the CustomMusic folder, place any additional songs you want in the music folder within.

I had to put this on google drive since its a large file 100mb file.
